Acidimstric - Accurately weigh about 1.2 g in a sealed ampoule. Place the ampoule in 50.0 ml of N sodium hydroxide contained in a stoppered 250-ml flask. Break the ampoule below the surface remove the of the liquid and shake, set aside for 10 minutes, stopper carefully, rinsing with a little water. Heat the Aask on a steam bath for 30 minutes.
